MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Multimodal Object is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Multimodal Object is or is intended to be located.

AVObjectID.description: Unique identifier of this Multimodal Object.

AVObjectTime.description: Time this Multimodal Object was produced.

AVObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Multimodal Object is located.

BasicAVObjectCount.description: Number of Basic Audio-Visual Objects contained in this Multimodal Object.

BasicAVObjects.description: Set of Basic Audio-Visual Objects contained in this Multimodal Object.

BasicAVObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Basic Audio-Visual Object is located within the containing Multimodal Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

BMObjectIDOrBMObject.description: Either the ID of a Basic Audio-Visual Object or the Basic Audio-Visual Object itself.

SubAVObjectCount.description: Number of child Multimodal Objects contained in this Multimodal Object.

SubAVObjects.description: Set of child Multimodal Objects contained in this Multimodal Object.

SubAVObjectSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this child Multimodal Object is located within the containing Multimodal Object. If absent, the Space/Time of the containing object applies.

SubMObjectIDOrSubMObject.description: Either the ID of a child Multimodal Object or the child Multimodal Object itself.

BMObjectOrMObject.description: A mixed array of Basic Audio-Visual Objects and child Multimodal Objects contained in this Multimodal Object.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Multimodal Object in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Multimodal Object (plain text, max 2048 characters).
